about_short_description.short_description: Storyboarder is a tool and platform that enables one to create, buy, and sell webcomics.

product.name: Storyboarder Webcomic Creation Tool
product.description: A web-based tool for creating webcomics using 3D scenes, handling shot composition, backgrounds, characters, and speech balloons.

product.name: Character Creator
product.description: A feature to create and customize fully rigged, poseable 3D characters with editable features and preset poses.

product.name: Asset Library and Marketplace
product.description: A collection of prebuilt and parametric assets for scenes, objects, and clothing, with a marketplace to buy or request new assets.

product.name: Script Editor
product.description: A script editor that converts typed dialogue and narration into automatically generated comic shots.

product.name: Platform Studio Organization
product.description: A cloud-synced workspace to organize storyboard files, story ideas, characters, scenes, and objects.

product.name: Real-Time Multiplayer Collaboration
product.description: A feature that allows multiple users to collaborate simultaneously on story creation within the platform.
